observation.command:
cd /workspace
# Check candidate ports are free
for p in 39001 39002 39003; do node -e 'const{createConnection}=require("net");const s=createConnection({port:parseInt(process.argv[1]),host:"127.0.0.1",timeout:400});const r=m=>{console.log(process.argv[1],m);process.exit(0)};s.on("connect",()=>r("BUSY"));s.on("error",()=>r("free"));s.on("timeout",()=>r("free"))' $p; done
# Set fixed ports
cat > /workspace/.urbo/workspace/ports.json <<'EOF'
{
  "app": 39001,
  "cms": 39002,
  "boards": 39003
}
EOF
echo "=== render nginx from these ports ==="
export GITHUB_TOKEN="ghp_dummytesttoken0000000000000000000000"
export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-21-openjdk-amd64; export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
timeout 300 just up --detach --no-seed > /tmp/render-final.log 2>&1; echo "render exit=$?"
echo "=== nginx upstream ports now ==="
grep -oE "172\.[0-9.]+:[0-9]+" /workspace/.urbo/workspace/nginx.conf | sort -u
echo "=== ports.json after render ==="; cat .urbo/workspace/ports.json
